verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents budgets and budget alerts (via Pub/Sub) and a billing API for programmatic cost control, configurable early via the $300 free-credit period [google-cloud-docs-9,26,21,10,22]. However, real-world community reports directly contradict the 'cannot silently explode' promise: a surprise $30k egress bill after following GCP's own storage advice, a $5k committed-use-discount typo with no undo, and production suspensions triggered by billing/fraud issues with no advance warning [google-cloud-comm-4,5,8,1]. There is also no documented anomaly-detection feature in the evidence pack, only manual budget thresholds. Missing for 10: explicit anomaly-detection docs, and evidence the budget/alert system actually prevented the cited surprise-bill incidents.
